nodes.label: Emblem KFV Freising
nodes.description: Combined emblem consisting of two heraldic shields side by side. nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo (Dark/Inverse Version)
nodes.description: Dark/inverse version of the KFV Freising (Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising) organizational logo. Wide horizontal SVG format (654.595×139.944 viewBox). Contains approximately 6,790 path elements representing highly detailed vector artwork. Uses white (#fff) fills for text and outlines against dark backgrounds, intended for placement on dark or colored surfaces. Brand colors: fire red (#f80c27, #f60d29, #e31517) for the fire department emblem/badge, white (#fbf7fc, #faf5fc, #fff) for typography and outlines, steel blue-gray (#84a3bb, #7d8da0) for secondary elements, near-black (#050712, #0b1125, #121a2d) for dark fill areas. Right section contains typography paths spelling out 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising'. Used in TYPO3 sitepackage as the inverse logo for dark mode headers and dark-background footers (referenced as {settings.Sitepackage.logoInverse} in Footer.html and as hidden dark:block element in Header.html).
